what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Türkiye in Belgium: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 4735 Turkish asylum seekers in Belgium, 4.0% of all asylum seekers from Türkiye.
Refugees from Türkiye, a separate group, live mostly in Germany, France, Canada and Switzerland.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over Kurdistan territory in Turkey with the PKK from 1998 to 2013 and from 2015 to 2025.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group from 2015 to 2017 and over the government in 2000, 2005 and 2016.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2003 at 404 asylum seekers.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2023 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Belgium.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Belgium only.
